data.title: Canadian Retail Sales Indicate Central Bank Can Be Patient — Market Talk
data.description: A modest rise in core Canadian retail sales in September and an advance estimate for a sizeable decline in October sales supports Capital Economics' view the Bank of Canada has scope to wait until the New Year to lift interest rates again. That is especially the case with oil prices at their lowest in almost three months, economist Bradley Saunders says. He says the estimated 1.5% decline in October retail sales is disappointing, especially given that gasoline prices only fell 2% last month so aren't entirely responsible for the move. This chimes with the message from the continued weakness in consumer confidence, and the jump in the share of firms reporting insufficient demand as a barrier to production, Bradley adds.(robb.stewart@wsj.com; @RobbMStewart)

data.title: REG - Ming Yang Smart Engy - Progress of Asset Acquisition
data.description:
RNS Number : 1256E Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Ltd 20 November 2026  

MING YANG SMART ENERGY GROUP LIMITED

(GDR under the symbol: "MYSE")

(a joint stock company established under the laws of the People’s Republic of China with limited liability)

Announcement on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions

I. Basic Information of the Transaction

Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") is planning to acquire 100% equity of Uniwatt Technology Co., Ltd. through the issuance of shares and cash payment and to raise supporting funds, which constitutes a related-party transaction (hereinafter referred to as "the Transaction"). According to the Administrative Measures for the Major Asset Restructuring of Listed Companies and other relevant regulations, the Transaction constitutes a related-party transaction but is not expected to constitute a major asset restructuring.

II. Progress of the Transaction

In accordance with the relevant regulations of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the trading of the Company's A share stock (stock abbreviation: MYSE, stock code: 601615) has been suspended from the opening of the market on January 13, 2026 (Tuesday, Beijing Time). The suspension lasts for no more than 10 trading days. For details, please refer to the Announcement on Trading Suspension in Respect of the Proposed Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions disclosed by the Company on January 13, 2026.

On January 22, 2026, the Company held the 30th meeting of the third Board, at which the Proposal on the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and other proposals related to the Transaction were reviewed and approved. For details, please refer to the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and other relevant announcements disclosed by the Company on January 22, 2026.

Upon application to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the trading of the Company's A share stock (stock abbreviation: MYSE, stock code: 601615) was resumed from the market opening on Friday, January 23, 2026. For details, please refer to the Announcement on General Risk Warning Regarding the Disclosure of the Restructuring Proposal and the Resumption of Trading of the Company's Stock disclosed by the Company on January 22, 2026.

On January 23, 2026, the Company received the Inquiry Letter on the Information Disclosure of the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition (SZGH [2026] No. 0129) (hereinafter referred to as the "Inquiry Letter") from the Listed Company Management Department I of the Shanghai Stock Exchange. In accordance with the Inquiry Letter, the Company has organized relevant parties to conduct careful verification, analysis, and research on the related matters, and has implemented and responded to them item by item. Meanwhile, the Company has revised, supplemented, and disclosed the Proposal on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited in accordance with the requirements of the Inquiry Letter and the relevant replies, which are marked in bold italic. For details, please refer to the Announcement on the Reply to the Inquiry Letter from the Shanghai Stock Exchange Regarding the Information Disclosure of the Proposal on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition and the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions (Revised Version) disclosed by the Company on February 5, 2026.

Since the disclosure of the proposal for the Transaction, the Company and all relevant parties have been actively advancing the work related to the Transaction. On February 23, March 23, April 22, May 22 and June 22, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transaction.

Since it was anticipated that the notice for convening the Shareholders' Meeting could not be issued within six months after the announcement date of the Board's resolution for the initial review of the Transaction, the Company disclosed the Special Explanation on the Progress of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and the Failure to Issue a Notice Convening a Shareholders' Meeting Within the Prescribed Time Limit on July 22, 2026.

On August 21, September 22 and October 22, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions.

As of the disclosure date of this Announcement, the relevant due diligence, audit, evaluation and other work have not yet been completed. Recently, the development stage of the downstream industry of the Target Company has undergone certain changes compared with the initial planning phase, and the Company and the relevant parties have engaged in renewed deliberations and negotiations on the core terms such as the transaction consideration, and have not yet reached a consensus. The Company will continue to work with relevant intermediary agencies to prudently evaluate the feasibility of continuing to advance the Transaction, and there is a possibility of major adjustments to or even termination of the transaction proposal. The Company will perform the relevant decision-making and approval procedures and information disclosure obligations in strict accordance with the relevant laws and regulations based on the progress of the Transaction.

III. Risk Warning

1. The Transaction is still in the planning stage, the relevant due diligence, audit, evaluation and other work have not yet been completed, the parties to the Transaction have not yet signed a formal transaction agreement, and all parties still need to perform the necessary internal and external decision-making and approval procedures, and there is a risk that it may not be approved through the relevant decision-making and approval procedures.

2. Since the planning of this transaction, the downstream industry of the target company has evolved in its development stage relative to the initial planning phase. The Company and all relevant parties have re-evaluated and renegotiated the core terms, including the transaction consideration, but have yet to reach a consensus. As a result, the transaction is subject to the risk of material adjustment to its structure and material uncertainty as to its continuation.

3. There is still uncertainty as to whether the Transaction can be finally implemented. All relevant information shall be subject to the announcements published by the Company on the designated information disclosure media. Investors are kindly reminded to make rational investments and be aware of investment risks.

Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited

November 20, 2026

data.title: Tech Slide Makes Crypto Markets Risk Averse
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - A massive negative sentiment in Wall Street, triggered by renewed worries about the artificial intelligence trade has spilled over to the cryptocurrency market. Worries about high interest rates, the massive outflows from U.S.-listed Bitcoin Spot ETF products as well as the heavy liquidation of crypto long positions abetted the decline. Overall crypto market capitalization has dropped 3.3 percent overnight to $2.11 trillion.

The CMC Crypto Fear and Greed Index which measures the overall sentiment in the crypto market is remaining at 10, denoting extreme fear.

With the enthusiasm surrounding Anthropic's IPO fading, Wall Street indexes are trading on a weak note. The Dow Jones is currently trading 0.19 percent higher at 49,189.19. The S&P 500 is trading 0.48 percent lower at 7,141.23. The Nasdaq Composite is trading 1.4 percent lower at 23,536.07.

Cryptocurrency markets witnessed a massive jump in liquidations. Aggregate liquidations during the 24-hour period stood at $818 million versus $363 million a day earlier. Liquidation of long positions increased to $713 million from $253 million a day earlier. Liquidation of short positions decreased to $105 million from $110 million a day earlier. Amidst the liquidation cascade, the overall cryptocurrency market capitalization has dropped to $2.11 trillion.

Markets continue to expect a quarter percent rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December. The probability of a quarter percent rate hike has increased to 95.8 percent from 93.9 percent a day earlier. Meanwhile, expectations of a half percent Fed rate hike in December have dropped to nil from 6.1 percent a day earlier and the likelihood of a status quo on rates has increased to 4.2 percent from nil a day earlier.

The dollar's retreat on Thursday limited losses in the crypto market sentiment. The six-currency Dollar Index which measures the Dollar's strength against a basket of 6 currencies is currently trading at 103.71, slipping 0.18 percent overnight.

Bitcoin (BTC), the largest cryptocurrency is currently trading 3.1 percent lower on an overnight basis at $61,886.34. Bitcoin is saddled with losses of 10.5 percent in the past week. Bitcoin traded between $63,981.13 and $61,196.31 during the past 24 hours.

Bitcoin Spot ETF products in the U.S. witnessed net outflows jumping to $582 million on Thursday from $307 million on Wednesday and $240 million on Tuesday. iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) topped with record net outflows of $541 million.

Following a blockbuster listing, AI giant Anthropic has been ranked in the 14th position in the global ranking of all assets as per market capitalization published by companiesmarketcap.com. As a result, Bitcoin has fallen one notch to the 15th position and is currently positioned between 14th ranked Anthropic and 16th ranked Berkshire Hathaway.

Ethereum (ETH) has plunged 3.2 percent overnight to $1,750.27. The leading alternate coin has lost 10.8 percent in the past week.

Ethereum Spot ETF products in the U.S. witnessed net outflows increasing to $131 million on Thursday from $40 million on Wednesday and $29 million on Tuesday.

iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) topped with net outflows of $124 million.

Ethereum has slipped 2 notches to the 86th position in the global ranking of all assets as per market capitalization published by companiesmarketcap.com.

4th ranked BNB (BNB), the native coin of the BNB Chain ecosystem has slipped 3.8 percent to $569.45. Weekly losses amount to 11.1 percent.

6th ranked XRP (XRP), a payments-focused cryptocurrency also erased 4.1 percent overnight. Weekly losses amount to 7.8 percent. XRP is currently trading at $0.9496.

The price of 7th ranked Solana (SOL) declined 4.9 percent overnight to $71.34. SOL has slipped 12.2 percent in the past week. U.S.-listed Solana Spot ETF products witnessed outflows of $1 million on Thursday versus nil flows on Wednesday.

TRON (TRX) ranked 8th overall is currently trading 2.2 percent lower at $0.3055.

9th ranked Hyperliquid (HYPE) plunged 7.8 percent on an overnight basis to $63.14. U.S.-listed Hyperliquid Spot ETF products witnessed net outflows steady at around $2 million on Thursday as well as Wednesday.

10th ranked Zcash (ZEC) tumbled 13.5 percent overnight and the cryptocurrency is currently trading at $817.95. U.S.-listed Zcash Spot ETF products witnessed net outflows of $1 million on Thursday versus $2 million on Wednesday.

data.title: BJ's Wholesale CEO Says Shoppers Remain Resilient — Market Talk
data.description: BJ's Wholesale Club's consumers remain resilient, CEO Bob Eddy says on a call with analysts. data.title: Benin opens 454m more deepened quays at Cotonou port under $176mn upgrade
data.description:
Benin’s Port of Cotonou has brought another 454 metres of newly built and upgraded quays into operation, raising the total delivered under its harbour expansion and renovation programme to 854 metres as the country seeks to handle larger container ships.

French construction group Eiffage (EPA:FGR) said on November 17 that it had completed and handed over two further sections to the Port Autonome de Cotonou (PAC): 300 metres of the northern quay, with a depth of 16 metres, and 154 metres of the southern quay, at 15 metres. Together with 400 metres at 16 metres’ depth delivered in January, the port now has 700 metres of upgraded quay at 16 metres and 154 metres at 15 metres. PAC has put the new sections into service.

Most of the work replaces and deepens existing quays rather than adding new length. Eiffage Génie Civil Marine leads the construction consortium alongside Spie batignolles Fondations and Beninese contractor Adéoti, with Tanger Med Engineering as project engineer.

The consortium won the design-and-build contract in July 2022, worth more than EUR160mn ($176mn), of which EUR119mn is Eiffage’s share. It covers the replacement and deepening of about 1,391 metres of existing northern quay, extensions of the northern and southern waterfronts, a roll-on/roll-off ramp and harbour dredging.

With about 700 metres of the northern quay delivered, roughly half of that section is complete, and the original 2022-2026 timetable ends in weeks. Eiffage said further work on the northern quay was continuing. Neither the company nor the port authority has given an updated completion date or said how much extra cargo the new sections will handle. The African Development Bank signed an EUR80mn funding agreement with the port authority in February 2025 to help modernise and extend the port.

To date, the works have involved more than 1.5mn cubic metres of dredging, 61,000 cubic metres of concrete, 24,000 square metres of paving and 3,250 tonnes of reinforcing steel, Eiffage said.

The port authority’s development programme aims to accommodate vessels longer than 300 metres and expand container capacity. Cotonou handled 14.7mn tonnes of cargo in 2025, up 52.3% from 9.65mn tonnes in 2024, and more than 500,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) of containers, Ecofin reported. The port is targeting 25mn tonnes a year and more than 1mn TEUs.

The expansion puts Cotonou in more direct competition with Togo’s port of Lomé, the region’s main transhipment hub. Traffic has been boosted by stronger transit flows to Burkina Faso and by oil exports from Niger, Ecofin has reported.

data.title: Mergers and acquisitions
data.description:
The following bids, mergers, acquisitions and disposals were reported by 1430 GMT on Friday:

** Grupa Azoty CEO Marcin Celejewski told reporters on Friday that the sale of the group's idle Polyolefins unit to state-controlled refiner Orlen would be completed this year, and did not rule out it happening in November.

** Fintech firm BILL Holdings said on Thursday it will be acquired by private equity group TPG, in partnership with Corpay , in an all-cash transaction valued at about $6 billion.

** Intuit said on Thursday it has agreed to sell email marketing platform Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68 billion, five years after acquiring it for nearly three times more in its largest deal ever.

** German media and services group Bertelsmann agreed to buy Turkey-based Ekol Logistics for more than €500 million ($548 million), the companies said on Thursday.

** Italy's biggest utility Enel said it had agreed to acquire a portfolio of solar plants in the US, bringing its installed renewable capacity in North America to 13.5 gigawatts (GW), including storage assets.

** Evonik's top shareholder, the RAG foundation, said it still aims to gradually reduce its stake in the German chemicals company to 25.1%, after BASF ended its pursuit of Evonik.

data.title: Top Democrat warns US law enforcement agencies to save records, including on apps
data.description:
Key points:
  • Raskin alleges 'widespread destruction' of documents
  • Incoming Judiciary chair: agencies must try to recover records
  • Letters sent to DOJ, DHS, FBI, ICE and prisons bureau

By Susan Heavey

The likely incoming head of the US House Judiciary Committee on Friday called on top Trump administration officials in the Justice and Homeland Security Departments, warning them to preserve all records, including electronic messages on Signal and other apps.

Democratic US Representative Jamie Raskin, who is poised to lead the panel when his party takes over Congress in January and launches a wave of investigations, also warned the federal law enforcement agencies to seek to recover any communications that were improperly deleted.

“There is significant evidence that Trump Administration officials have engaged in the widespread destruction, mutilation, and concealment of government records, seemingly with the express purpose of circumventing federal record preservation laws,” Raskin wrote.

"This attempt to evade transparency extends to the highest levels of federal agencies, including top-ranking law enforcement officials,” he added in the letters, sent to U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin as well as the heads of the FBI, the Bureau of Prisons and the Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

Federal law requires US agencies to preserve records regarding official government business, and Congress holds oversight power into the executive branch.

Democrats, who won control of both the US House of Representatives and the US Senate in the November 3 midterm elections, are preparing a blitz of probes into Republican President Donald Trump's administration, from its immigration crackdown and construction projects to alleged Trump family corruption and the Nvidia scandal.

They have also planned to investigate Trump's corporate donors as well as other companies and financial firms surrounding the president, law firms that made deals with Trump and other targets.

"The Justice Department follows all legal requirements for the management of federal records involving its official functions and decisions," a department spokesperson said, adding that its staffers would "not be intimidated."

Representatives for the Department of Homeland Security, the Federal Bureau of Investigations and the Bureau of Prisons and ICE did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

In his letters, the Maryland Democrat cited reports received by the committee of Trump administration officials using "a platform specifically configured to erase communications" to conduct US government business.

Raskin included a screenshot of a Signal chat that he said was between FBI general counsel Samuel Ramer and Drew Lynch, an associate of Donald Trump Jr, over a possible investigation into someone wanted by US authorities on health fraud charges.

Donald Trump Jr, speaking broadly at an Axios event earlier this week, denied any alleged corruption or wrongdoing.

Other Democrats have already begun probing reports that a Russian oligarch paid for Donald Trump Jr's wedding celebrations earlier this year.

Raskin gave the five agencies and departments until December 3 to comply.

data.title: Anthropic Stock Slides as Tech Rout Intensifies — WSJ
data.description:
By Ed Ballard

The selloff in technology stocks is intensifying.

The Nasdaq is down more than 1% as investors continue to pull money out of AI stocks, and Anthropic shares are tumbling, giving up a large part of their day-one gains.

Investors are now watching whether the stock will slip below its IPO price of $83 a share.

The Claude maker's blockbuster debut Thursday did little to allay fears about the broader AI trade. "The AI buildout still needs vast amounts of funding just as financing costs are rising and signs of credit stress are emerging," said Swissquote's Ipek Ozkardeskaya. The prospect of tighter chip-export rules also is a worry, she added.

The tech-led rout is dragging the S&P 500 lower. The index is headed for its seventh down day in a row, for the first time since the onset of the coronavirus pandemic.

The selling rippled through Asian markets that had been buoyed by this year's boom in semiconductor stocks. Taiwan's TAIEX, which includes chipmaking giant TSMC, shed more than 6% and logged its worst weekly performance since 1990 (it's still up roughly 25% for the year). European AI plays such as ASML and Infineon also are dropping.

U.S. Treasurys are climbing, sending yields lower, as investors seek safe assets. The yield on the 10-year note has dipped below 5%. The dollar is hovering near a one-year high.

data.title: Qualified Upgrades Its ZoomInfo Integration to the GTM.AI API, Bringing Verified Company and Contact Data to Piper
data.description:
ZoomInfo (), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, today announced that Qualified from Salesforce has upgraded its ZoomInfo integration to the ZoomInfo GTM.AI API. Qualified now enriches website visitor profiles through the API's company and contact enrichment endpoints, replacing the legacy WebSights and Enterprise APIs, so Piper, Qualified's agent, works from verified ZoomInfo company and contact data.

For Qualified customers, the integration works as it did before. They connect their ZoomInfo account in Qualified, and visitor profiles are enriched automatically, with no change to their setup.

The integration enriches each website visitor at two points. When a visitor arrives on a customer's website, Qualified uses reverse IP enrichment to add ZoomInfo company data to the visitor's profile. When a visitor shares an email address, Qualified uses email enrichment to add ZoomInfo contact data.

Both enrichment steps run automatically, at the same two points every time. The data flows into Qualified visitor fields, the context Qualified holds on each website visitor. Customers choose which fields Piper can use in conversations and which fields drive deterministic workflows such as segmentation and routing.

The API gives partners and customers programmatic access to ZoomInfo's verified company and contact data. The Qualified integration uses two of its endpoints, company enrichment and contact enrichment, and only the fields those endpoints return.

Customers connect the integration with their existing ZoomInfo account.

“Qualified customers already generate pipeline with Piper,” said Dennis Sevilla, Chief Strategy Officer at ZoomInfo. “ZoomInfo adds verified company and contact data to every visitor profile. Piper starts each conversation knowing more about who she is talking to, and teams can segment and route visitors on data they trust.”

Qualified customers can connect ZoomInfo from the Qualified settings page at app.qualified.com/settings/zoominfo. Customers who do not see the option can contact their Qualified Success Architect (QSA). Details are also available on the ZoomInfo integrations page at zoominfo.com/integrations/qualified.

The upgrade puts Qualified on the same GTM.AI API that ZoomInfo partners use to bring verified company and contact data into their platforms.

About ZoomInfo

ZoomInfo (), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.

GTM.AI is a headless layer that connects to ZoomInfo's GTM Context Graph. It is the API and Model Context Protocol home for AI agents, powering integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI, Perplexity, and dozens more.

Learn more at zoominfo.com and gtm.ai.
